card.name: The word that after comparisons
card.fires_on: The word "that" right after a comparison such as "higher than", "lower than" or "comparable to", where it stands for an earlier noun. Weaker hits come on a few other words that end or continue a phrase.

modes.label: Comparison then that
modes.description: "that" after higher than, lower than or comparable to, standing in for an earlier rate or dose.
modes.example: The effective dose of succinylcholine chloride injection in pediatric patients may be higher than<< that>> predicted by body weight dosing alone.

modes.label: Other scattered words
modes.description: Occasional hits on other words, such as the end of an adverb or a word after "longest".
modes.example: The Landsat program is the longest<< running>> enterprise for acquisition of imagery of Earth from
